title: Label legacy task verification as agent-reported
description:
Compatibility slice of the human-confirmed CheckRun decomposition. Objective: distinguish an agent's existing complete_task verification claim from runner-reported candidate-bound CheckRun evidence without changing whether legacy projects can complete work.

Deliverable in exactly five owned paths: packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts extends TaskVerification with optional source:'agent-reported' (optional for old records); tools/completeTask.ts persists that literal after normal validation; tools/getContext.ts projects the literal on both primary task.verification and declared-prerequisite verification; tools/completeTask.test.ts and tools/getContext.test.ts prove the real production writer/readers. Existing missing verification remains null. Existing reports without a source are projected as agent-reported without a read-time disk write. Do not let an imported/manual/caller-provided source label elevate a TaskVerification to runner-observed. The main task's verification projection preserves command/exitCode/outputTail/reportedAt, while the compact prerequisite projection still omits outputTail.

Use existing util/enforcement.ts assertVerificationEvidence UNCHANGED: required evidence, nonzero refusal, command trimming, 500-character command cap and final 2000-character output tail all retain their old semantics. complete_task keeps ownership/step/branch/error precedence and its REVIEW/finalizing transition. Place source:'agent-reported' AFTER spreads so it cannot be overridden, and do not add source to the accepted complete_task verification input schema. No candidate id exists for this legacy path; never synthesize a Candidate or write a fake bound CheckRun. Store the label in the existing task.verification object and expose it there, including when no attempt/candidate/checks directory exists, autoCommit=false or there is no Git repository.

Depends on the store slice ONLY to serialize the shared schema.ts edit and its preceding QA-binding schema/getContext work. The original task-867f69a6 remains the complete recorder DoD gate and will document this behavior in docs/MCP_SERVER.md. NOT in scope: CheckRun store/tool/registry, new commands, verification validation/refusal changes, source authentication, policy/QA/dependency gates, migrations, IDE/wrapper edits, or held-out acceptance-test edits/unskips.

Verification at repo root Windows: cmd /d /c "cd /d packages\moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/completeTask.test.ts src/tools/getContext.test.ts && npm test && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json". macOS/Linux: (cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/completeTask.test.ts src/tools/getContext.test.ts && npm test && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json). Require nonzero counts and exact old-writer/read behavior assertion red, not a compile failure. Do not run build/prebuild/clean or discard peer state.
definitionOfDone: Real complete_task persists task.verification.source exactly agent-reported while preserving command, exitCode, outputTail and reportedAt semantics, proven from disk and a fresh StateManager reload.

Real get_context exposes agent-reported for both the primary task and declared-prerequisite projections of legacy source-less records without rewriting their files; null/missing verification remains null and sibling outputTail remains omitted.
Tests prove attempted caller or persisted-label promotion cannot produce runner-observed TaskVerification, and no Candidate/CheckRun/runner identity is fabricated.
Existing verification validation/refusal behavior and complete_task REVIEW/finalizing transitions remain unchanged, with no edits to util/enforcement.ts or held-out tests.
Tests cover legacy no-attempt/no-candidate/no-git and autoCommit=false completion paths plus compact sibling projection, preserving existing fields and failures.
Named focused tests, npm test and tsc all exit 0 with nonzero executed counts; an assertion regression fails against the old source-less writer/readers, and only the five owned files change.
taskRails: TaskVerification remains candidate-less agent attestation; never upgrade it to runner-observed or manufacture a CheckRun.
Do not weaken or reimplement assertVerificationEvidence, change its input shape or apply the new CheckRun byte cap to legacy outputTail.
Preserve landed QA candidate-binding behavior and all foreign hunks when editing getContext/schema.
No policy gate or held-out-test unskip belongs to this compatibility slice.

implementationPlan.description: CONFIRM LANDED PREREQUISITES AND THE FIVE-FILE BOUNDARY (read-only). Before editing, re-fetch context and prove store task-214bcfa37db24628aab11689764b4ae2 landed via landing.merged or a matching Moe-Task commit trailer on the delivery branch; its dependency also serializes the preceding QA candidate-binding changes. An undelivered prerequisite means report_blocked naming it, not copying its changes. Re-read TaskVerification, assertVerificationEvidence, completeTaskTool, both getContextTool verification projections, existing finalizing-attempt tests, and the newly landed schema/getContext hunks. Record HEAD, status and foreign paths; preserve peer bytes. This compatibility slice owns only schema.ts, completeTask.ts/test and getContext.ts/test. It labels existing agent attestation; it never records or synthesizes a Candidate, CheckRun, runner identity or delivery proof. Freeze the unchanged legacy contract: command length checked before trimming, maximum 500 characters, exitCode exactly zero, final 2000 JavaScript string characters of outputTail, absent/empty tail omitted. Parent task-867f69a6cdb748a8ab68fcbeec0de711 owns public MCP documentation and the complete recorder gate; this task owns no held-out acceptance edits or unskips.

WRITE REAL WRITER/READER REGRESSIONS FIRST. Extend completeTask.test.ts and getContext.test.ts using their existing temporary-directory fixtures, real StateManager.load and production tool handlers; no mocked validator or replacement serializer. Writer: complete a no-attempt/no-candidate project with no Git repository, parameterized for autoCommit absent and false, then assert the exact verification object in memory, task JSON and a fresh StateManager reload: source agent-reported, normalized command, exitCode 0, exact tail and server reportedAt (the same stamp as reviewStartedAt). Cover omitted/empty tail, whitespace trimming, 500-character success versus 501-character refusal before trimming, and a multibyte tail longer than 2000 string characters that is sliced exactly as before, not by the CheckRun byte cap. A direct handler caller supplying an extra source runner-observed must still persist agent-reported; inputSchema verification properties and additionalProperties:false remain unchanged and do not advertise source. Assert no candidate/check records or attempt/runner identity is fabricated and the legacy nextAction/result shape remains unchanged. Add source assertions to the existing real open-attempt completion case without weakening its exact finalizing/REVIEW assertions. Preserve or extend exact MoeError code/codeName assertions for missing/malformed evidence, blank/oversize command, non-integer/nonzero exitCode, invalid tail, ownership/step/state and branch-policy precedence; rejected calls leave the legacy task bytes and verification unchanged. Inject updateTask rejection in a no-attempt case and assert the same error escapes with no successful completion or persisted label. Reader: seed source-less, explicit agent-reported, and manually persisted runner-observed/source-null records; call getContextTool for a primary task plus declared dependsOn and blockedOnTaskIds prerequisites. Assert source exactly agent-reported in both projections, primary command/exitCode/outputTail/reportedAt unchanged, compact prerequisites omit outputTail, missing/null verification stays null, and ordinary undeclared siblings stay unenriched. For read-only provenance checks, explicitly stub MOE_WORKER_ID empty and supply taskId without workerId so existing contextFetchedBy/touchWorker bookkeeping is not triggered; restore env afterwards. Snapshot primary/prerequisite disk bytes and in-memory verification after load, invoke context twice, and prove neither changes; mutate the returned verification copy and prove state remains unchanged. Retain separate existing bookkeeping and currentCandidate tests unchanged. Capture focused assertion-red results against the existing source-less writer and both readers before production edits; use typed response records or unknown JSON at malformed-fixture boundaries so missing properties/compile errors are not the red. Clear each original and reload StateManager emitter, restore spies/env/clocks, and clean only each test's own temporary root without changing the shared harness.

LABEL THE LEGACY MODEL AND COMPLETION WRITE, WITHOUT MOVING GUARDS. Add source?: 'agent-reported' to TaskVerification in schema.ts, with a short comment that optionality loads old records and this candidate-less surface is agent attestation, not runner-observed CheckRun evidence. Preserve all CheckRun/Candidate/QA types landed by prerequisites. In completeTask.ts change only the verification object in the existing state.updateTask REVIEW write: spread the result of the existing assertVerificationEvidence, stamp reportedAt as today, and force source:'agent-reported' AFTER the spread. Never spread raw caller verification or take caller source. Do not change the inputSchema, input type, util/enforcement.ts or its return construction, caps and error handling. Keep task lookup/status/ownership/completed-step/evidence/branch-policy order, finalizing-before-REVIEW ordering, worker release and existing nextAction logic intact. No catch that turns persistence failure into success; no new attempt/candidate lookup, Git call, CheckRun write, migration or source authentication. The optional literal preserves the existing Omit<TaskVerification,'reportedAt'> validator return type without modifying the validator.

LABEL BOTH CONTEXT PROJECTIONS WITHOUT A MIGRATION. In getContext.ts replace the primary raw verification reference with a fresh shallow projection when verification exists, preserving its existing fields and forcing source:'agent-reported' AFTER the spread; absent/null stays null. In siblingEntry's declared-prerequisite verification object add the same literal while retaining its explicit command, exitCode and reportedAt field list and excluding outputTail. Do not return the persisted source even if it says runner-observed, and do not assign into task.verification or write a normalized record during the read. No new helper module is needed for these two small projections. Preserve get_context's pre-existing caller bookkeeping, chat failure handling, declared-dependency selection/caps, currentCandidate selection/copy semantics and all QA candidate-binding additions. Add only a concise why-comment explaining legacy projection labels are not an upgrade of provenance. Missing verification must never become a fabricated object; no candidate, check or runner field is introduced. Public contract documentation is deliberately delegated to the already-planned parent recorder task rather than adding a sixth owned file.

ONE FINAL VERIFICATION GATE. Load regression-check and verification-before-completion. Retain the meaningful pre-implementation red evidence for the real writer and both readers, with failing source assertions and test names; a type error, missing import, or broken fixture does not satisfy regression red. Run this exact completion command from repo root on Windows: cmd /d /c "cd /d packages\moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/completeTask.test.ts src/tools/getContext.test.ts && npm test && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json". macOS/Linux: (cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/completeTask.test.ts src/tools/getContext.test.ts && npm test && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json). Every command must exit 0, with nonzero executed Test Files/Tests counts for focused and full runs; record actual counts and remaining skips, not merely a green process. This shared schema/wire change requires full daemon regression even though it is mid-epic; do not replace npm test with only the focused files. tsc excludes test files, so do not claim it type-checks them. Preserve all pre-existing finalizing/branch/QA/held-out assertions; no held-out edits or unskips. Do not build/prebuild/clean, delete shared dist, mask peer failures or disturb foreign source. All filesystem fixture setup/cleanup uses Node path utilities on verified temporary roots, not shell-composed recursive deletion.

FINAL ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW AND QA HANDOFF. Load adversarial-self-review and review only this five-file diff as a caller trying to upgrade an agent claim. Check a manual persisted runner-observed source cannot leak through either projection; a caller-provided label cannot override the writer; read/re-read/response mutation cannot rewrite or alias stored legacy verification; null does not fabricate evidence; and no command/exit/tail fields or compact-sibling limits are lost. Re-check empty/null/huge numeric/string inputs against unchanged validation, persistence-failure propagation, existing finalizing retry semantics and normal mutex serialization without adding a new concurrency mechanism. Confirm no candidate/check/runner/Git/policy authority was invented and autoCommit=false/manual/no-git completion remains supported. Review exact prerequisite landing evidence, source schema diff and preservation of all peer QA-binding hunks; held-out tests and util/enforcement.ts remain byte-identical to the worker's post-prerequisite baseline. Record commands/counts, old-behavior red evidence, five-path scope, compatibility semantics and the parent-owned documentation obligation in the task handoff. Report every actually created/modified path in complete_step.modifiedFiles, empty for read-only steps; never broad-stage or self-approve. Use complete_task for QA/runtime delivery, not BLOCKED as a completion substitute. If self-review changes owned bytes, refresh the same final gate. Whole-epic integration remains task-808869c56228430ca5b15cb901497544, not another hardening task here.

completionSummary:
Legacy complete_task evidence is now labelled agent-reported. Whether a legacy project can complete is unchanged.

- **schema.ts:** TaskVerification gains optional `source?: 'agent-reported'`, so old rows still load.
- **completeTask.ts:** persists `{ ...validated, reportedAt: now, source: 'agent-reported' }`.
  - The label goes after the spread, so a caller's source, reportedAt, runnerId or candidateId is ignored.
  - inputSchema and util/enforcement.ts are unchanged: raw command capped at 500 characters before trim, exitCode === 0, final 2000 JS string units kept, empty tail omitted.
- **getContext.ts:** the primary `task.verification` is a fresh copy, `{ ...stored, source: 'agent-reported' }`.
  - Null or missing stays null, and a hand-edited runner-observed or null label is overridden.
  - The read writes nothing back, and the response no longer aliases state.
  - Declared-prerequisite `epicSiblings` verification gains `source` and still omits outputTail.
- **No authority invented:** no Candidate, CheckRun, attempt, runner or git record is read or fabricated. Completion with autoCommit absent or false and no git repository is tested.

**Tests:** +26 writer cases in completeTask.test.ts and +9 reader cases in getContext.test.ts.
- Before implementation, 14 named assertion reds against the old writer and readers.
- Scratch mutation audit: 22 of 22 mutations red; the unmutated run was 79/79 first and last.

**Gate:** focused 79/79, npm test 116 files with 1725 passed and 3 skipped, tsc 0. Exactly the five owned paths changed, all via the Edit tool; QA should confirm with `git show --stat <completion sha>`.

**Docs:** handed to parent task-867f69a6 in comment-1938cc2c: MCP_SERVER.md:200/214/432, plus SCHEMA.md:408, which no task owns.

issues.description: Test 'never rewrites or aliases the stored rows it labels, across repeated reads' seeds primary task-1 only with source 'runner-observed'. No test reads a source-less primary and asserts nothing was written. QA scratch mutation, before listCandidatesForTask: `if (task?.verification && !task.verification.source) await state.updateTask(task.id, { verification: { ...task.verification, source: 'agent-reported' } })`. getContext.test.ts stays 27/27 while task-1.json is rewritten on read.

The same gap exists in memory. A primary projection that uses the spread only when source is present, and otherwise does Object.assign(task.verification, { source: 'agent-reported' }), labels the stored source-less row and returns it aliased. It also stays 27/27. The response-tamper check covers only the runner-observed primary, so aliasing or mutating a source-less legacy primary row is unguarded.

To pass: add a source-less primary to the read-only proof, e.g. parameterize it over source-less and runner-observed primaries. Keep MOE_WORKER_ID stubbed empty and pass no workerId. Assert over two reads: updateTask/touchWorker not called, stored verification strictly equal to the seeded row, task file bytes unchanged, response tampering never reaches state. QA confirmed such a case passes on 3297ed7 and fails under both mutations. Test-only, within the 5 paths. Re-run the gate.
